row.notes: myteam-g2: Finds the team entry in attr_set+0x2c8..+0x2d0 (0x30 stride, id short +2 / kind byte +0), takes the refcounted attribute container (+0x20/+0x28) and returns the clamped float value of the attribute whose id equals attr_id (value at attr+0x78, clamped to def min/max at def+0xc/+0x10). Same structure written by Career_Bank_OnBankAccountValidTransactionMessage. Hook: read any My Team stat here. CORRECTION(V9016): Team entry lookup (stride 0x30, short +2 / byte +0) and attribute lookup by id via FUN_1409ed390 are right, returns 0 if not found or attr id null. Correction: disassembly of FUN_1409ed390 shows the returned value is clamp(float at attr+0x7c, def min/max at def+0xc/+0x10 with presence flags +0x14/+0x15), not attr+0x78; +0x78 is the field the valid-transaction handler writes, +0x7c is the effective one.
